2609.18587.title: Label-free steering: Compressing test-time reinforcement learning into bias-only subspaces
2609.18587.paper_summary: Test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) enables models to improve their reasoning without relying on labeled training data, but existing approaches typically optimize a large fraction of the model parameters. This raises a natural question: can effective test-time adaptation emerge when both the reward signal and the optimization space are severely restricted? We answer this question with label-free bias-only TTRL, which uses majority-vote pseudo-labels as rewards and optimizes only approximately 100K bias parameters while keeping the pretrained backbone frozen. On MATH-500, our approach reaches 76.67% accuracy, slightly exceeding our own labeled bias-steering reproduction while optimizing 76,000x fewer parameters than full-parameter TTRL. The same training procedure improves performance across vision-language and audio reasoning tasks, including MathVista, AI2D, LogicVista, and MMAU. We further show that the learned steering vectors transfer to 4,500 held-out MATH problems, indicating that the adaptation is not limited to the problems used during test-time optimization. Finally, we analyze why this highly restricted adaptation can work, showing that majority-vote reliability improves with rollout consensus and that bias subspaces with greater accessible gradient energy exhibit stronger downstream trainability. These results demonstrate that substantial test-time adaptation can emerge from optimizing a tiny bias-only subspace using entirely label-free rewards.
2609.18587.paper_summary_zh: 測試時增強學習（TTRL）使模型能在不依賴標記訓練數據的情況下改善其推理能力，但現有的方法通常會優化大量的模型參數。這引發了一個自然的問題：當獎勵信號和優化空間都受到嚴重限制時，能否出現有效的測試時適應？我們用無標籤的偏差僅 TTRL 來回答這個問題，它使用多數投票的偽標籤作為獎勵，並僅優化大約 100K 的偏差參數，同時保持預訓練的主幹不變。在 MATH-500 上，我們的方法達到了 76.67% 的準確率，略微超過了我們自己的標記偏差引導重現，同時優化的參數比全參數 TTRL 少了 76,000 倍。相同的訓練程序在視覺-語言和音頻推理任務中改善了性能，包括 MathVista、AI2D、LogicVista 和 MMAU。我們進一步顯示，學習到的引導向量可以轉移到 4,500 個保留的 MATH 問題，這表明適應並不僅限於在測試時優化中使用的問題。最後，我們分析了為什麼這種高度限制的適應能夠有效，顯示多數投票的可靠性隨著展開共識而改善，且具有更大可訪問梯度能量的偏差子空間表現出更強的下游可訓練性。這些結果表明，通過使用完全無標籤的獎勵來優化一個微小的偏差僅子空間，可以出現實質的測試時適應。
